question: With which sport is Sanjana Bathula associated?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Roller Skating**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanjana Bathula** is a renowned sportsperson associated with **Roller Skating**.
 
• Roller Skating is a sport that involves moving on surfaces with the help of **specialized shoes fitted with rollers or wheels**.
 
• This sport requires a high level of **balance, coordination, agility, and speed**.
 
• **Sanjana Bathula** has represented India at several **national and international roller skating competitions** and has earned recognition for her skills.
 
• Roller skating is widely practiced for both **recreational and competitive purposes**.
 
• It is included in various events such as **speed skating, artistic skating, and roller hockey.**
 
• Roller Skating has become increasingly popular among youths, particularly in countries like **India, the USA, and China.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Squash**__

 __
 
• Squash is a **racquet sport** played between two players (singles) or four players (doubles) in a four-walled court.
 
• The players alternate in hitting a small, hollow rubber ball against the front wall.
 
• It is popular in countries like **England, Egypt, and the USA**.
 
• Unlike roller skating, squash emphasizes **hand-eye coordination, speed, and endurance.**
 
 
 
• **Shooting**__
 __
 
• Shooting is a sport that involves **precision and accuracy** in aiming and hitting a target using firearms or air guns.
 
• This sport is divided into various categories such as **rifle shooting, pistol shooting, and trap/skeet shooting.**
 
• It is a popular event in the **Olympics** and other international competitions.
 
• Shooting requires **concentration, focus, and control**, unlike the physical agility needed in roller skating.
 
 
 
• **Badminton**__
 
 
• Badminton is a popular **racquet sport** played using a shuttlecock and racquets, usually between two or four players.
 
• The game is played on a **rectangular court** divided by a net.
 
• It emphasizes **speed, reflexes, and stamina** and is especially popular in **Asian countries like China, India, and Indonesia.**
 
• Prominent Indian players like **P.V. Sindhu and Saina Nehwal** have gained international fame in Badminton.
